looks_why: A is a restrained, consistent grey/slate palette with a single coral accent and a proper title block. B mixes pastel teal, orange, cyan and green boxes with a pink stick figure, thick black lifelines and a tiny off-centre title.

weak_B: heavy black lifelines, multicolour boxes with no meaning, tiny title

clearer_why: A shows the 18 numbered steps at a comfortable text size in a single downward column, so every label is easy to read and the yes/no branches are easy to follow. looks_why: B is a compact, composed figure with a legend, rounded boxes and tidy orthogonal routing, which would sit well in a README. A is a long, plain grey column with wobbly S-curved edges and cramped placement around steps 9 and 10.
weak_A: four screens tall, plain default look, S-curved edges, steps 9 and 10 cramped
weak_B: text shrinks to about 7 CSS px and the flow wraps across three columns with long return edges

weak_B: wide layout shrunk to tiny text; relation labels hard to read; no crow's-foot notation

weak_B: small text (about 7 CSS px) and long wrap-around edges between columns
